hook: Bullfrog muscle powers a wireless manta‑ray robot
what_happened: Researchers isolated a frog gracilis muscle, wired it to a near‑infrared laser‑powered neural stimulator, and drove a manta‑ray‑shaped robot to swim
why_it_matters: It shows native muscle can deliver 6.5 N force, overcoming the weak output of engineered tissues and enabling high‑mobility biohybrid robots
the_catch: The muscle stayed responsive for only 11 days, and the robot still depends on an external light source to move
caption: A frog’s leg becomes a high‑performance actuator for a wireless manta‑ray robot
alt_text: Five slides explaining how a frog muscle was used to power a wireless manta‑ray robot, highlighting the muscle’s force, the laser‑driven stimulation, the robot’s speed, its limitations, and the breakthrough it represents
attribution: Zhang et al., Advanced Functional Materials (2026)

es.hook: El músculo de la rana bullfrog impulsa un robot manta‑ray inalámbrico
es.what_happened: Los investigadores aislaron un músculo gracilis de rana, lo conectaron a un estimulador neural alimentado por láser de infrarrojo cercano y dirigieron un robot con forma de manta‑ray para nadar
es.why_it_matters: Demuestra que el músculo nativo puede generar 6.5 N de fuerza, superando la débil salida de tejidos diseñados y permitiendo robots biohíbridos de alta movilidad
es.the_catch: El músculo permaneció receptivo solo 11 días, y el robot sigue dependiendo de una fuente de luz externa para moverse
